top_signals.title: Gold Wavers as Oil Eases With Traders Focused on Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Gold swung as oil’s rally cooled and US Treasury yields retreated, with traders focused on the outlook for inflation and the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan’s Turkey Securities Unit Plans to Cease Operations
top_signals.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s securities unit in Turkey said it planned to cease operating in the country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
